title: 第238章 他只出手过一次第237章 你这么喜欢我行我素
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
千年以来，这是她第一次被人以这样的语气命令和训斥，她的眼死死地望着面前的这个家伙，胸脯剧烈地起伏，拳头紧握，已经是恨不得将他当场镇杀。
她心中气结，因为如果是她其他的姐姐倒也无所谓，但是被一个乳臭未干的毛头小子这么压制，她说不生气绝对是假的。
“我要亲自和纱夜姐姐对话！”
她语气冰冷道。
林恩深吸了一口气，沉声道：
“那你就自己上去问，看看女武神陛下到底是站我，还是站你。”
而这句话更是让柩目光激烈地波动，鼻中的气息变得极为的粗重，因为她要是能上去裂隙之外，那她还在这里和他废什么话，她早就已经上去亲自面见她的姐姐，问问她这一切到底是怎么回事，为什么她会突然切断和她们所有人的联系，而且还指派了这么一个家伙来当她在人间的代言。
她一声不吭，目光几乎能够杀人，指甲几乎都刺入手心。
“好了。”
林恩有条不紊地继续推进，目光依旧逼人。
“这段时间你就跟着我，不要离开我的视线之外，我会调查出刺杀奥菲希尔的元凶，但你记住，这不是为了你，是为了我，也是为了女武神陛下，你就乖乖地听我指挥，我们相安无事。”
说完之后，林恩直接就从她的身前走过，平静地向着远处的街道而去。
直到来到一处厕所前。
林恩侧眼，看着那个死死地注视着他的后背，跟着他站在十几米开外的那个女人。
“上厕所就不用跟了，在那儿等着，当然你要是想进来，那也随你。”
“你！”
而也就是在柩想要爆发时，林恩已经是关上了大门，只留下柩在外面满眼杀气，眼眶血红，恨不得将他杀之而后快。
……
“哈啊！哈啊！”
厕所中，林恩（.;?;:益:;?;.）地贴在墙壁之上，心脏跳的就像是战鼓一样。

“做到了！做到了啊！”
其实要说不紧张那当然是假的，因为就在刚才把后背露给她的时候，他已经十几次感受到了她想要对他动手的意思，而毫无疑问，如果她真的没有控制住自己的情绪，直接给他来一刀的话，那他绝对是打不过这个女人的，而更重要的是本体也肯定会暴露。
而最主要的是，这个家伙强的真的就像是一个怪物。
从他从教堂出来一直到现在，他已经有几十次感觉到她在暗中试图用各种各样的方法对他进行窥探，甚至在靠近她时，他都感觉到她在暗中动用了某种力量试图渗透进入他的体内，但好在他严防死守，这才没有被她侵入。
这个女人虽然嘴上默认了他是神选。
但是实际上心里一点都不信他，她一直在找机会试图把他翻个底朝天。
不过收获也并不是没有。
林恩侧眼，微微从门缝看了一下外面。
至少从表面上来说，他暂时还是把她压住了，虽然在资料当中的确是那种我行我素的性格，就算在所有的神侍中也是刺头的那种，但是至少在心里依旧是听从女武神话的，而且从乙烯利的行为中也能看出，她也是那种比较重感情的人。
毕竟千年的时间过去了。
看着身边的好友接二连三地离开，自己也在一点点地与时代脱轨，而越是如此，她才越发珍惜那来之不易的友情，所以奥菲希尔出事之后才会让她如此动容。
而林恩也已经从神泉纱夜那里搞到了很多关于她的资料。
“果然不是人……”
林恩侧眼道。
“长生种……魔人……只能在现实中活动……接近永生的血统么……”
也不知道她和长子比起来到底谁会更厉害一点，毕竟看样子来说她是老牌的强者，而长子是在最近百年来才崛起的天才。
但是至少有一点可以确定，她的实力绝对算得上是教会在这个世界的天花板之一。
一个真正的九阶的能力者！
“这要是能把她留到绯红之主发动侵袭前，那岂不是就可以立于不败之地？”
……

……
“好了。”
很快，林恩如厕归来，闭着眼睛，道貌岸然地出现在了她的面前。
柩没有说话，只是目光冰冷地望着他，既没有靠近，也没有远离，显然他之前强压她的话，让她对他的观感有了进一步地降低。
林恩转过了头，望向了那条已经被封锁的街道，目光跳动道：
content_en:
This was the first time in thousands of years that she had been ordered and reprimanded in such a tone. Her eyes were fixed on the guy in front of her, her chest was rising and falling violently, her fists were clenched, and she already wanted to kill him on the spot.
She was angry, because it wouldn't matter if it was her other sisters, but being suppressed by a young boy like this, she would definitely be lying if she said she wasn't angry.
"I want to talk to Sister Saya in person!"
She said in a cold tone.
Lin En took a deep breath and said in a deep voice:
"Then you go up and ask yourself to see if Her Majesty the Valkyrie is siding with me or you."
And this sentence caused the coffin's eyes to fluctuate intensely, and the breath in her nose became extremely heavy, because if she could go up to the outside of the rift, what nonsense would she still be talking to him here? She would have already gone up to meet her sister in person, asking her what all this was about, why she suddenly cut off contact with all of them, and appointed such a guy to be her spokesperson in the world.
She said nothing, her eyes were almost killing, and her nails almost pierced her palms.
"Okay."
Lin En continued to advance methodically, his gaze still compelling.
"You just follow me during this period and don't leave my sight. I will investigate the culprit who assassinated Offishier. But remember, this is not for you, but for me, and for Her Majesty the Valkyrie. Just obey my command obediently, and we will be fine."
After saying that, Linn walked directly in front of her and walked calmly towards the street in the distance.
Until I came to a toilet.
Linn glanced sideways, looking at the woman who was staring at his back and standing more than ten meters away with him.
"You don't have to follow me when you go to the bathroom. Just wait there. Of course, if you want to come in, that's up to you."
"You!"
And just when Coffin was about to explode, Lin En had already closed the door, leaving Coffin outside with murderous eyes and blood-red eyes, wanting to kill him quickly.
…
"Haah! Haah!"
In the toilet, Lin En (.;?;:Yi:;?;.) was pressed against the wall, her heart beating like a war drum.
"I did it! I did it!"
In fact, it would be a lie to say that he was not nervous, because when he exposed his back to her just now, he had already felt her intention to attack him more than a dozen times, and there was no doubt that if she really did not control her emotions and stabbed him directly, then he would definitely not be able to beat this woman, and more importantly, his true body would definitely be exposed.
And the most important thing is that this guy is really as strong as a monster.
From the time he came out of the church until now, he has felt her secretly trying to spy on him in various ways dozens of times. Even when he was close to her, he felt that she was secretly using some kind of power to try to penetrate into his body. Fortunately, he guarded tightly and was not invaded by her.
Although this woman tacitly acknowledged that he was the chosen one.
But in fact, she didn't believe him at all. She was always looking for opportunities to try to turn him upside down.
But the gains are not without success.
Linn glanced sideways and looked outside through the crack of the door.
At least on the surface, he suppressed her for the time being. Although according to the data, she does have a character that goes her own way, and is the thorny one among all the gods, but at least in her heart she still obeys the myth of the female warrior, and it can be seen from Ethron's behavior that she is also the kind of person who values ​​emotions.
After all, thousands of years have passed.
Watching her friends leave one after another, she was also falling out of step with the times, and the more this happened, the more she cherished the hard-won friendship, which is why she was so moved after Ofishil's accident.
And Lin En has already obtained it from Shenquan SayaLots of information about her.
"It's really not a human being..."
Linn glanced sideways.
"Immortal species... demons... can only move in reality... are they of bloodline close to immortality..."
I don't know who is more powerful between her and the eldest son. After all, it seems that she is a veteran strongman, while the eldest son is a genius who has only emerged in the past hundred years.
But at least one thing is certain, her strength is definitely one of the ceilings of the Church in this world.
A true ninth-level ability user!
"If we can keep her until the Crimson Lord launches his invasion, wouldn't that make her invincible?"
…
…
"Okay."
Soon, Linn came back from going to the toilet and appeared in front of her sanctimoniously with her eyes closed.
Coffin didn't speak, but looked at him with cold eyes, neither approaching nor moving away. Apparently, his previous words to suppress her had further reduced her perception of him.
